- [EVENT] The user expressed interest in the Turks and Caicos Islands and asked for more information about diving conditions and the best time to visit.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided details about diving conditions in the Turks and Caicos Islands, including:
  - Water temperature ranges from 78°F (25°C) in winter to 84°F (29°C) in summer.
  - Visibility averages 100-150 feet (30-45 meters), sometimes up to 200 feet (60 meters).
  - Currents are generally mild, suitable for divers of all levels.
  - Dive sites range from shallow reefs to deep walls and wrecks, with maximum depths of around 100-150 feet (30-45 meters).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended the best time to visit as December to April, with peak season from December to March and off-season from May to November.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant listed top dive sites in the Turks and Caicos Islands, including:
  - The Wall
  - Northwest Point
  - The Crack
  - The Library
  - Wreck dives like the HMS Endymion and SS Sapona.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided safety tips, including choosing a certified operator, diving with a buddy, and being respectful of the marine environment.
